description:
FILED s532a (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-01), found writing ir-spec Â§3.2d's #4086 example.  PRE-EXISTING (base 10cdc985 identical).  A missing die (the program runs on where perl stops).

    eval { for ("lit") { s/x/z/ } }; print "1 ", ($@ ? "died" : "ok"), "\n";   # perl died   PCL ok
    eval { for ("lit") { tr/x/z/ } }; print "2 ", ($@ ? "died" : "ok"), "\n";  # perl died   PCL died
    eval { for ("lit") { s/l/L/ } }; print "3 ", ($@ ? "died" : "ok"), "\n";   # perl died   PCL died

perl's pp_subst checks the target's read-only flag BEFORE it matches (s/// on a constant dies even when nothing would change); tr/// already does.  PCL's s/// only reaches the read-only check on the write.  Layer: cl/pcl-runtime.lisp p-subst's target write path (the #1391 marked read-only slot).  Probe: scratch/s532a/p/ro.pl in the s532a worktree.

=== DONE (s537a, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-10 .. 11-13; commit c217684d on the s537a branch, rebased over MAIN-READY-87; shas as of the rebase over main b620405f) ===
FIXED: the read-only box (`%p-ro-box`, a literal in a promoting foreach list) now carries the magic kind `:readonly`, asked by ONE predicate `%p-readonly-box-p`.  `do-regex-subst` dies "Modification of a read-only value attempted" BEFORE it matches when the target is such a box and the op is not `/r` -- a miss dies, `/g` too, and an `/e` replacement never runs (perl's pp_subst).  `do-tr`: an IDENTICAL tr (perl's OPpTRANS_IDENTICAL: a count) no longer writes its target at all, so `for ("lit") { $n = tr/a-z// }` and `tr/a-z/a-z/` LIVE (perl lives; PCL died -- a second, pre-existing divergence in the same rule); any other tr writes matched or not and dies on a read-only target as before.  ir-spec §6.2.
PROBES (scratch/s537a/p/m6a.pl, 19 shapes perl / main / tree): tree = perl on 15; the four left are shapes the read-only MARK does not reach yet -- a constant sub's value, map's / grep's `$_` over a literal, `for (sort ...)` -- noted on #1391 (they will die by this rule once marked).  `$1 =~ s/zzz/q/` lives in perl and PCL (a capture variable is not this read-only).
GUARD: Pl/t/fatals-01.t read-only rows "s/// miss on literal" .. "s/// miss on range" (8 rows, want = perl 5.40.3 verified; inverse on main: 5 fail).
BARS (the combined tree over MAIN-READY-87, HEAD 7cd511ac): FULL gate 369 / 12,018 -> 12,046 PASS (+ tr-01.t row 9 = 12,047); FULL sweep GATE clean 0 new / 0 fixed / 0 LOST, TOTAL 18,795 -> 18,796 (tr.t +1 = #1493, by edit), drops 5 = census; corpus-diff vs 23f0f917 3 / 111; wide emission A/B 2,053 files 29 DIFF explained / RCDIFF 0; gate-SET scan 638 files IDENTICAL over both populations; ir-host-leak 31 = 31; ir-conform 328 / 0; EVERYDAY 116 -> 116 of 122 (NEW 0); compile time unchanged (Calc.pm 5.52 -> 5.51 s).
